about.title: Premium Guided Motorcycle & 4x4 Expeditions Across the Himalayas
about.body: Offhorizon Adventure delivers premium guided motorcycle and self-drive 4x4 expeditions across the Trans-Himalayan region. We operate in high-altitude terrain with carefully structured routes, professional support teams, and small group formats. Every expedition is fully guided, safety-focused, and built for those who want real adventure without compromising on organization or quality.

footer.about: Offhorizon Adventure is a premium motorcycle and 4x4 expedition company specializing in guided journeys across the Himalayas of India, Nepal, and Bhutan. We design and lead expeditions through some of the most remote and iconic regions, including Ladakh, Spiti Valley, Zanskar, and Upper Mustang, delivering real adventure experiences with professional support.

meta.title: About Offhorizon Adventures | Himalayan Expedition Specialists
meta.description: Guided motorcycle and 4x4 expeditions across five countries: India, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka and Mongolia. Ten years of ground experience, a 16-strong crew, and routes through Ladakh, Spiti, Zanskar and Upper Mustang.

hero.title: Himalayan expeditions, <accent>done right</accent>.
hero.lead: We plan and lead guided motorcycle and 4x4 expeditions across five countries: the Himalayas of India, Nepal and Bhutan, then Sri Lanka and Mongolia. Ladakh, Spiti Valley, Zanskar, Upper Mustang. Remote country, run with the discipline it demands.

start.title: BRB Expeditions opens in Manali
start.body: We began in 2014 with <brb>BRB Expeditions</brb>, renting motorcycles and 4x4s from Manali and Bhuntar to riders heading for Ladakh, Spiti and the wider Himachal. Thousands of riders have gone out on our machines since.

learned.label: What we learned
learned.title: Things you cannot get from a manual

items.terrain: How Himalayan roads behave across a season
items.altitude: What altitude does to riders and to engines
items.vehicles: How a machine holds up once the tarmac ends
items.logistics: Running support when help is hours away

today.label: Today
today.title: Two divisions, one workshop floor
today.body: As the work grew we split it in two, so each side could be done properly rather than partly.

divisions.rentals: Rentals and on-ground vehicle support across Himachal.
divisions.expeditions: Guided motorcycle and 4x4 expeditions, built on that decade of ground experience.

team.title: The people behind the journey
team.body: An expedition is only as good as the people running it. Ours have spent years reading this terrain, this weather and these machines, which is what keeps a trip on schedule when conditions turn.
team.leadNote: Runs the business and sets the standard every expedition is measured against.

riders.title: The clearest account of what we do is not written by us
riders.body: Riders share their journeys on Google, TripAdvisor and Trustpilot. Read what they say about the routes, the landscapes and the crew who kept them moving.
riders.thanks: To everyone who has ridden with us: thank you. Your stories are the reason we keep planning the next one.

rewards.title: Ride once and you are part of the family
rewards.body: Straightforward benefits for riders who come back, book together, or plan early. Stated plainly, with the conditions in the open.

returning.title: Returning rider
returning.body: Off your next expedition once you have completed your first tour with us. Valid on all eligible departures.

group.title: Group booking
group.body: Per rider for groups of four to six, rising to seven percent for groups of seven to ten.

early.title: Early booking
early.body: Book at least twelve months before departure. The exact figure depends on the tour and availability.

full.title: Paid in full
full.body: Off the base tour price when the whole amount is settled at the time of booking.

rewards.philosophy: No tiers, no points, no small print games. We put the effort into the things that actually decide a trip: sound machines, expert local crew, routes worth riding, and a price you can read at a glance.

conditions.availability: All discounts depend on tour availability and the conditions of that specific tour.
conditions.atBooking: Discounts must be requested and applied at the time of booking.
conditions.noStacking: Discounts cannot be combined, stacked, or applied after the fact.
conditions.changes: We may change or withdraw an offer without prior notice.

meta.title: Contact Offhorizon Adventures | Plan Your Himalayan Expedition
meta.description: Talk to the team about a guided motorcycle or 4x4 expedition across India, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka or Mongolia. Based in Manali, replying within one working day.

hero.title: Tell us where you want to ride.
hero.lead: Send the route you have in mind, or just the month you are free. We will come back with what is realistic, what it costs, and what the road is like at that time of year.

direct.title: Prefer to talk directly?
direct.body: The office is in Manali, which is where most of our routes begin. Call, write, or come and find us.

reply.title: We reply within one working day
reply.body: A real person from the operations team, not an autoresponder.

plan.title: We shape the route with you
plan.body: Dates, group size, machine, and what the terrain is doing that season.

confirm.title: You confirm when you are ready
confirm.body: A small deposit holds your seat. Nothing is charged before you decide.

meta.title: Field Notes | Offhorizon Adventures
meta.description: Notes from the road across the Himalayas. Altitude, terrain, machines and route planning, written by the crew who run the expeditions.

hero.title: Notes from the road.
hero.lead: What we have learned running expeditions at altitude. Written by the people who ride the routes, not by a marketing desk.

meta.title: Custom Expeditions | Offhorizon Adventures
meta.description: Tell us where you want to ride, when, and who with. We build guided motorcycle and 4x4 expeditions to order across India, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka and Mongolia.

hero.title: Your route, your dates, your group.
hero.lead: Fixed departures do not suit everyone. Tell us what you have in mind and we will build the expedition around it, then come back with a plan and a price.

fields.destination: Where do you want to go
fields.budgetHint: Per person, roughly. A range is fine.
fields.message: Tell us a bit more about your adventure
fields.messagePlaceholder: Passes you want to ride, places you want to stop, anything we should plan around.

custom.successBody: Thanks. We will look at the dates and terrain and come back to you with a plan.

aside.title: How a custom trip comes together
aside.body: We read the enquiry, check what the route is doing in your window, and send back an outline with a price. Nothing is booked until you say so.
aside.note: Riding season in the high passes runs roughly June to September. Outside that window some routes are closed, and we will tell you rather than sell you a trip that will not run.

noPayment.title: No payment to enquire
noPayment.body: Ask as many questions as you like before anything is committed.

reply.title: A reply within one working day
reply.body: From the operations team, not an autoresponder.

tailored.title: Built around your group
tailored.body: Pace, distance and stops set by who is actually riding.
